entities.summary: Dornstetten is a town in the district of Freudenstadt in Baden-Württemberg in southern Germany. It is situated in the Black Forest, 7 km (4.3 mi) east of Freudenstadt. It was founded in the early Middle Ages and is well known for its half-timbered houses.
